data.title: Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners - by Provider Data Dictionary

fields.name: Rndrng_NPI
fields.label: National Provider Identifier
fields.description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) for the rendering provider on the claim. The provider NPI is the numeric identifier registered in NPPES.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_Last_Org_Name
fields.label: Last Name/Organization Name of the Provider
fields.description: When the provider is registered in NPPES as an individual (entity type code=’I’), this is the provider’s last name. When the provider is registered as an organization (entity type code = ‘O’), this is the organization name.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_First_Name
fields.label: First Name of the Provider
fields.description: When the provider is registered in NPPES as an individual (entity type code=’I’), this is the provider’s first name. When the provider is registered as an organization (entity type code = ‘O’), this will be blank.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_MI
fields.label: Middle Initial of the Provider
fields.description: When the provider is registered in NPPES as an individual (entity type code=’I’), this is the provider’s middle initial. When the provider is registered as an organization (entity type code = ‘O’), this will be blank.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_Crdntls
fields.label: Credentials of the Provider
fields.description: When the provider is registered in NPPES as an individual (entity type code=’I’), these are the provider’s credentials. When the provider is registered as an organization (entity type code = ‘O’), this will be blank.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_Ent_Cd
fields.label: Entity Type of the Provider
fields.description: Type of entity reported in NPPES. An entity code of ‘I’ identifies providers registered as individuals and an entity type code of ‘O’ identifies providers registered as organizations.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_St1
fields.label: Street Address 1 of the Provider
fields.description: The first line of the provider’s street address, as reported in NPPES.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_St2
fields.label: Street Address 2 of the Provider
fields.description: The second line of the provider’s street address, as reported in NPPES.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_City
fields.label: City of the Provider
fields.description: The city where the provider is located, as reported in NPPES.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_State_Abrvtn
fields.label: State Abbreviation of the Provider
fields.description: The state where the provider is located, as reported in NPPES. The fifty U.S. states and the District of Columbia are reported by the state postal abbreviation. The following values are used for all other areas:

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_State_FIPS
fields.label: State FIPS Code of the Provider
fields.description: FIPS code for rendering provider's state.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_Zip5
fields.label: Zip Code of the Provider
fields.description: The provider’s zip code, as reported in NPPES.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_RUCA
fields.label: RUCA Code of the Provider
fields.description: Rural-Urban Commuting Area Codes (RUCAs), are a Census tract-based classification scheme that utilizes the standard Bureau of Census Urbanized Area and Urban Cluster definitions in combination with work commuting information to characterize all of the nation's Census tracts regarding their rural and urban status and relationships. The Referring Provider ZIP code was cross walked to the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) 2010 Rural-Urban Commuting Area Codes.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_RUCA_Desc
fields.label: RUCA Description
fields.description: Description of Rural-Urban Commuting Area (RUCA) Code

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_Cntry
fields.label: Country Code of the Provider
fields.description: The country where the provider is located, as reported in NPPES. The country code will be ‘US’ for any state or U.S. possession. For foreign countries (i.e., state values of ‘ZZ’), the provider country values include the following:

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_Type
fields.label: Provider Type of the Provider
fields.description: Derived from the provider specialty code reported on the claim.  For providers that reported more than one specialty code on their claims, this is the specialty code associated with the largest number of services.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_Mdcr_Prtcptg_Ind
fields.label: Medicare Participation Indicator
fields.description: Identifies whether the provider participates in Medicare and/or accepts assignment of Medicare allowed amounts.  The value will be ‘Y’ for any provider that had at least one claim identifying the provider as participating in Medicare or accepting assignment of Medicare allowed amounts within HCPCS code and place of service.  A non-participating provider may elect to accept Medicare allowed amounts for some services and not accept Medicare allowed amounts for other services.

fields.name: Tot_HCPCS_Cds
fields.label: Number of HCPCS
fields.description: Total number of unique HCPCS codes.

fields.name: Tot_Benes
fields.label: Number of Medicare Beneficiaries
fields.description: Total Medicare beneficiaries receiving services from the provider. The beneficiary counts reported in the demographic sub-groups (i.e., age, sex, race and entitlement) may not aggregate to the ‘Number of Unique Beneficiaries’ due to the suppression of beneficiaries fewer than 11 within the demographic sub-groups.  In addition, a small percentage of beneficiaries are reflected in the “Number of Unique Beneficiaries” but are not reflected in the beneficiary demographic information due to the lack of demographic information available at the time of reporting.

fields.name: Tot_Srvcs
fields.label: Number of Services
fields.description: Total provider services.

fields.name: Tot_Sbmtd_Chrg
fields.label: Total Submitted Charge Amount
fields.description: The total charges that the provider submitted for all services.

fields.name: Tot_Mdcr_Alowd_Amt
fields.label: Total Medicare Allowed Amount
fields.description: The Medicare allowed amount for all provider services. This figure is the sum of the amount Medicare pays, the deductible and coinsurance amounts that the beneficiary is responsible for paying, and any amounts that a third party is responsible for paying.

fields.name: Tot_Mdcr_Pymt_Amt
fields.label: Total Medicare Payment Amount
fields.description: Total amount that Medicare paid after deductible and coinsurance amounts have been deducted for all the provider's line item services.

fields.name: Tot_Mdcr_Stdzd_Amt
fields.label: Total Medicare Standardized Payment Amount
fields.description: Total amount that Medicare paid after deductible and coinsurance amounts have been deducted for the line item service and after standardization of the Medicare payment has been applied. Standardization removes geographic differences in payment rates for individual services, such as those that account for local wages or input prices and makes Medicare payments across geographic areas comparable, so that differences reflect variation in factors such as physicians’ practice patterns and beneficiaries’ ability and willingness to obtain care.

fields.name: Drug_Sprsn_Ind
fields.label: Drug Suppress Indicator
fields.description: Identifies whether the utilization, cost and payment information associated with HCPCS codes for drug services as listed on the Medicare Part B Drug Average Sales Price (ASP) list have been suppressed.  An '*' identifies that the suppressed information is based on fewer than 11 beneficiaries and a '#' identifies that the information has been counter suppressed  to prevent the re-calculation of  information suppressed due to fewer than 11 beneficiaries.  For example, if the information associated with Drug services has been suppressed because fewer than 11 beneficiaries received these services from a provider, then the information associated with Medical services must also be suppressed so that the information associated with Drug services cannot be recalculated by subtracting the Medical values from the provider's overall values.

fields.name: Drug_Tot_HCPCS_Cds
fields.label: Number of HCPCS Associated With Drug Services
fields.description: Total number of HCPCS codes for drug services, as defined from the Medicare Part B Drug ASP File.

fields.name: Drug_Tot_Benes
fields.label: Number of Medicare Beneficiaries With Drug Services
fields.description: Total Medicare beneficiaries receiving drug services, as defined from the Medicare Part B Drug ASP File.

fields.name: Drug_Tot_Srvcs
fields.label: Number of Drug Services
fields.description: Total drug services, as defined from the Medicare Part B Drug ASP File.

fields.name: Drug_Sbmtd_Chrg
fields.label: Total Drug Submitted Charge Amount
fields.description: The total charges that the provider submitted for drug services, as defined from the Medicare Part B Drug ASP File.

fields.name: Drug_Mdcr_Alowd_Amt
fields.label: Total Drug Medicare Allowed Amount
fields.description: The Medicare allowed amount for drug services, as defined from the Medicare Part B Drug ASP File. This figure is the sum of the amount Medicare pays, the deductible and coinsurance amounts that the beneficiary is responsible for paying, and any amounts that a third party is responsible for paying.

fields.name: Drug_Mdcr_Pymt_Amt
fields.label: Total Drug Medicare Payment Amount
fields.description: Total amount that Medicare paid after deductible and coinsurance amounts have been deducted for all the provider's line item drug services, as defined from the Medicare Part B Drug ASP File.

fields.name: Drug_Mdcr_Stdzd_Amt
fields.label: Total Drug Medicare Standardized Payment Amount
fields.description: Total amount that Medicare paid after deductible and coinsurance amounts have been deducted for the line item drug service, as defined from the Medicare Part B Drug ASP File and after standardization of the Medicare payment has been applied. Standardization removes geographic differences in payment rates for individual services, such as those that account for local wages or input prices and makes Medicare payments across geographic areas comparable, so that differences reflect variation in factors such as physicians’ practice patterns and beneficiaries’ ability and willingness to obtain care.

fields.name: Med_Sprsn_Ind
fields.label: Medical Suppress Indicator
fields.description: Identifies whether the utilization, cost and payment information associated with HCPCS codes for Medical (non-ASP) services have been suppressed.  An '*' identifies that the suppressed information is based on fewer than 11 beneficiaries and a '#' identifies that the information has been counter suppressed  to prevent the re-calculation of  information suppressed due to fewer than 11 beneficiaries.  For example, if the information associated with Medical (non-ASP) services has been suppressed because fewer than 11 beneficiaries received these services from a provider, then the information associated with Drug services must also be suppressed so that the information associated with Medical services cannot be recalculated by subtracting the Drug values from the provider's overall values.

fields.name: Med_Tot_HCPCS_Cds
fields.label: Number of HCPCS Associated With Medical Services
fields.description: Total number of HCPCS codes associated with medical (non-ASP) services.

fields.name: Med_Tot_Benes
fields.label: Number of Medicare Beneficiaries With Medical Services
fields.description: Total Medicare beneficiaries receiving medical (non-ASP) services.

fields.name: Med_Tot_Srvcs
fields.label: Number of Medical Services
fields.description: Total medical (non-ASP) services.

fields.name: Med_Sbmtd_Chrg
fields.label: Total Medical Submitted Charge Amount
fields.description: The total charges that the provider submitted for medical (non-ASP) services.

fields.name: Med_Mdcr_Alowd_Amt
fields.label: Total Medical Medicare Allowed Amount
fields.description: The Medicare allowed amount for medical (non-ASP) services. This figure is the sum of the amount Medicare pays, the deductible and coinsurance amounts that the beneficiary is responsible for paying, and any amounts that a third party is responsible for paying.

fields.name: Med_Mdcr_Pymt_Amt
fields.label: Total Medical Medicare Payment Amount
fields.description: Total amount that Medicare paid after deductible and coinsurance amounts have been deducted for all of the provider's line item medical (non-ASP) services.

fields.name: Med_Mdcr_Stdzd_Amt
fields.label: Total Medical Medicare Standardized Payment Amount
fields.description: Total amount that Medicare paid after deductible and coinsurance amounts have been deducted for the line item medical (non-ASP) service, as defined from the Medicare Part B Drug ASP File and after standardization of the Medicare payment has been applied. Standardization removes geographic differences in payment rates for individual services, such as those that account for local wages or input prices and makes Medicare payments across geographic areas comparable, so that differences reflect variation in factors such as physicians’ practice patterns and beneficiaries’ ability and willingness to obtain care.

fields.name: Bene_Race_Wht_Cnt
fields.label: Number of Non-Hispanic White Beneficiaries
fields.description: Number of non-Hispanic white beneficiaries.  Race/ethnicity information is based on the variable RTI_RACE_CD from the CMS CCW enrollment database. The RTI_RACE_CD variable is based upon a validated algorithm that uses Census surname lists and geography to improve the accuracy of race/ethnicity classification, particularly for those who are Hispanic or Asian/Pacific Islanders.

fields.name: Bene_Dual_Cnt
fields.label: Number of Beneficiaries With Medicare & Medicaid Entitlement
fields.description: Number of Medicare beneficiaries qualified to receive Medicare and Medicaid benefits. Beneficiaries are classified as Medicare and Medicaid entitlement if in any month in the given calendar year they were receiving full or partial Medicaid benefits.

fields.name: Bene_Ndual_Cnt
fields.label: Number of Beneficiaries With Medicare Only Entitlement
fields.description: Number of Medicare beneficiaries qualified to receive Medicare only benefits. Beneficiaries are classified as Medicare only entitlement if they received zero months of any Medicaid benefits (full or partial) in the given calendar year.

fields.name: Bene_CC_BH_ADHD_OthCD_V1_Pct
fields.label: Percent (%) Of Beneficiaries Identified With ADHD And Other Conduct Disorders
fields.description: Percent of beneficiaries meeting the CCW chronic condition algorithm for ADHD and other conduct disorders.  Please note that this condition was not updated as part of the 2020 technical expert panel (TEP) to refine and enhance chronic conditions algorithms, hence the V1 component of the variable name.  Chronic condition metrics are only available for file years 2017 forward.  For more details on this condition, see https://www2.ccwdata.org/web/guest/condition-categories-other.  To protect the privacy of Medicare beneficiaries, the number of beneficiaries fewer than 11 have been suppressed and the percent of beneficiaries between 75% and 100% have been top-coded at 75%.

The V2 portion of the variable name indicates that this variable was updated as part of the TEP.  Chronic condition metrics are only available for file years 2017 forward. For more details on this condition, see https://www2.ccwdata.org/web/guest/condition-categories-chronic. To protect the privacy of Medicare beneficiaries, the number of beneficiaries fewer than 11 have been suppressed and the percent of beneficiaries between 75% and 100% have been top-coded at 75%.
